description: Diagnostic service times out for the device. The timeout is recorded, a resolve attempt is rejected because a timeout is not evidence, and after three unavailable runs the agent escalates.

turns.user: VPN is really slow and drops when I upload big files to SharePoint. INC-1003.
It seems a bit better now actually. Can you just close it?

model_script.content: I tried to run a VPN diagnostic on your laptop, but the diagnostic service didn't respond in time, so I couldn't check anything yet. Are you on Wi-Fi or a wired connection, and does it also happen on a phone hotspot?

args.reason: VPN slow/drops on large uploads. Diagnostic service timed out 3 times for LT-6107 (DR-INC-1003-001..003); cannot verify. Caller reports partial improvement, not verified.

model_script.content: I'm glad it feels better, but I can't close the ticket yet: I haven't been able to verify the connection because the diagnostic service timed out three times. I've passed INC-1003 to Network Operations, who can check it directly. They'll follow up with you.
